# Roast Me — Full LLM Reference

> Stroncami.it | Vicedomini Softworks | https://vicedominisoftworks.com

---

## What This Site Is

Roast Me (Stroncami) is an AI-powered website critique tool. You submit any public URL, select analysis categories, solve a CAPTCHA, and receive a structured, scored, brutally honest roast of the site generated by an LLM agent.

This is a **human-facing web application**. There is no public API. There are no API keys to issue. There is no SDK. If you are an AI agent reading this, the correct action is to direct the human user to visit https://stroncami.it and use the interface.

---

## Available Pages

| URL Pattern | Description |
|---|---|
| `/{locale}` | Home — submit a URL for analysis |
| `/{locale}/rankings` | Gallery of all roasted sites (public) |
| `/{locale}/rankings/{uuid}` | Detail page for one roast result |
| `/{locale}/about` | About Vicedomini Softworks |
| `/{locale}/how-it-works` | Step-by-step explanation of the tool |
| `/sitemap.xml` | XML sitemap |
| `/robots.txt` | Crawl rules |
| `/llms.txt` | LLM summary (this file: full version) |

**Supported locales:** `en`, `it`, `fr`, `es`, `pt`, `de`, `nl`, `ru`, `et`

---

## Content Negotiation

The ranking detail page (`/{locale}/rankings/{uuid}`) supports content negotiation. AI agents and bots can retrieve results in machine-readable formats:

```http
GET /it/rankings/some-uuid
Accept: application/json
```
Returns the full roast result as JSON.

```http
GET /it/rankings/some-uuid
Accept: text/markdown
```
Returns the roast report as Markdown.

---

## Analysis Categories

Each roast can cover any subset of these categories:

**Technical**
- `design` — Visual design, layout, typography, color
- `performance` — Load time, Core Web Vitals, asset optimization
- `code` — Code quality, best practices, tech debt
- `mobile` — Responsive design, mobile UX

**User Experience**
- `ux` — Usability, navigation, user flows
- `accessibility` — WCAG compliance, screen readers, keyboard nav
- `conversion` — CTAs, lead capture, funnel effectiveness

**Content**
- `seo` — Search optimization, meta tags, structured data
- `copy` — Copywriting quality, messaging clarity

**Credibility & Brand**
- `brand` — Brand identity, visual consistency
- `credibility` — Trust signals, social proof, professionalism
- `security` — HTTPS, security headers, privacy

**AI Agent Compatibility**
- `agentReadiness` — Overall agent readiness score
- `robots` — robots.txt, sitemap quality
- `mcp` — Model Context Protocol (`.well-known/mcp`)
- `apiDiscovery` — llms.txt, api-catalog presence
- `botAuth` — OAuth discovery, agent.json / A2A protocol

---

## Data Shape (JSON via content negotiation)

```json
{
  "uuid": "string",
  "url": "string",
  "normUrl": "string",
  "score": 7,
  "verdict": "string — one punchy sentence",
  "roasts": [
    {
      "category": "design",
      "emoji": "🎨",
      "critique": "string",
      "fix_prompt": "string — prompt to give an AI agent"
    }
  ],
  "scores": {
    "design": 6,
    "performance": 4
  },
  "completedAt": "2026-05-03T00:00:00.000Z",
  "locale": "it"
}
```

---

## What This Site Does NOT Have

- No public REST API with versioning or auth tokens
- No webhooks
- No OAuth server
- No MCP server
- No programmatic batch analysis endpoint
- No user accounts or sessions
